method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation incorporating amendments up to the Statutes (Minor Amendments) Act 2017 s 10 (in operation 13 September 2017); last reprint listed Reprint 2 as at 22 February 2013; legislation.wa.gov.au mrdoc_49104, retrieved 7 September 2026. No regulation deposited: the s 7(1)(eb) prescribed amount (s 21B) is an input.

scope: ss 4(1), (4), (4a), 6(1)-(5), (7), (8), 7A(1), 7(1)(a)-(e), (2A), (2), (3), 14(2), 19, 20(4), (5), 21B (input); out: transitional provisions, Trustees Act s 65 orders (ss 8, 9), urgent distributions (s 11), s 12(2), class funds (s 13), form, costs, rescission, increase and commutation of orders (ss 14(1), (3)-(7), 15-17), replacing an administrator (s 18), the administrator's protection (s 20(1)-(3)), evidence (s 21A), rules of court
seat: the family member left out of a will or the intestacy (spouse, de facto partner, former spouse maintained by the deceased, child, grandchild, stepchild or parent) asking whether they may claim provision out of the estate

roles: I am a family member who may have been left out of the estate, or left too little
I take a share of the estate under the will or on intestacy
I am the executor or administrator of the estate

situation_parameters.name: probate or administration has been granted in Western Australia
questions: What is the last day to claim without leave
Will my claim be heard, or is it out of time

situation_parameters.name: I have applied to the Court and my claim is undecided
questions: May the Court give me an interim order

situation_parameters.name: estate property the evidence on my claim did not reveal has come to light
questions: May I make a further claim for undisclosed property

situation_parameters.name: the Court has ordered provision for me
questions: How much of my provision falls on one beneficiary's share

situation_parameters.name: I have given a mortgage, charge or assignment over my provision
questions: Is my mortgage or assignment of my provision of no effect

situation_parameters.name: the administrator has been given notice of an intended claim
questions: When does a notice of intended claim lapse

situation_parameters.name: I advised the administrator in writing that I consent, or that I will not apply
questions: Have I given up my action against the administrator

situation_parameters.name: the Court has ordered provision for a claimant
questions: How much of the claimant's provision falls on my share

situation_parameters.name: I have distributed, or propose to distribute, part of the estate
questions: Can a claimant sue me for distributing the estate
